build_sparse_mask_channel: build a SparseMaskChannel instance to compress FL messages using topk or random sparsity masking
create_sparse_mask_channel_config: create a SparseMaskChannelConfig dataclass to set sparsity method, zero weight proportion, and compression format
test_compute_mask: test the compute_mask method to generate a sparsity mask using random or topk pruning on model parameters
refactor_apply_mask: refactor the apply_mask method to multiply model state dict parameters element-wise with a provided sparsity mask
